findings.title: Incorrect early exit if manifests directory does not exist.
findings.detail: The script exits immediately when the manifests directory is missing, preventing any further checks or processing. This can lead to incomplete or no output being generated.
findings.fix: Move the exit call to after all necessary checks and processing.

findings.title: Incorrect line count calculation.
findings.detail:
The script counts lines in the generated runtime, but `split('
').length` includes an extra line for the last newline character. This can cause incorrect output in logs and potentially mislead users.
findings.fix:
Use `split('
').length - 1` to correctly count the number of lines.
